question.text: A Young's double-slit experiment is performed using monochromatic light of wavelength <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">λ</mi></math>. The intensity of light at a point on the screen, where the path difference is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">λ</mi></math>, is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math> units. The intensity of light at a point where the path difference is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi mathvariant="normal">λ</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac></math> is given by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>nK</mi><mn>12</mn></mfrac></math>, where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></math> is an integer.
